newsitem.title: USA: Hertz Corp may set $150 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Hertz Corp may set $150 mln in debt.

text.p: Hertz Corp is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $150 million debt offering, syndicate sources said on Tuesday.
The deal, which is expected to include a five-year maturity, will be underwritten by lead manager JP Morgan Securities, sources said.

Last month, the rental car firm issued its debut 20 million share initial public offering, which priced at the top of its range at $24 per share, according to JP Morgan, who served as lead underwriter on that deal as well.
Hertz Corp is the world's largest car rental company and is a unit of Ford Motor Co.
